g.title: #1 ResistorDividerSeparatedFromChip <ResistorDividerSeparatedFromChip hostComponentName="U1" supplyResistorName="R1" groundResistorName="R2" message="Place the divider R1 / R2 beside its connected pin on the left side of U1. Both resistors are beyond the opposite chip edge. Keep supply above ground and make the tap connection direct, preserving values, symbols and all pin connections. Leave room for labels and reroute affected traces." />

text.tspan: R1 / R2: divider is beyond the opposite chip edge; FB wraps around U1.
Divider beside the left-facing FB pin; the tap connection is direct.
